 BB 20: Manish Goel Opens Up About Childhood Trauma, Reveals Suicide Attempt As A Teenager, Says “Only Mom Knows”
 Sakshi Singh | 18.NOV.2026 Link copied to clipboard 
 The latest episode of Bigg Boss 20 took an emotional turn after television actor Manish Goel opened up about a deeply painful experience from his childhood. Following a heated exchange with fellow contestant Qazi Touqeer during a nomination task, the Anupamaa actor revealed that he had attempted suicide when he was just 12 or 13 years old. The revelation came after Manish Goel struggled to deal with remarks that brought back memories of his school years. He also suffered an asthma attack following the confrontation, leaving several housemates concerned about his health.
 Bigg Boss 20: Why Did Manish Goel Get Upset With Qazi Touqeer? 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality) 
 The disagreement began during a nomination activity in which contestants were required to throw sherbet at the housemates they wanted to nominate. When Manish Goel’s turn arrived, Qazi Touqeer confronted him about their strained equation and accused him of being overly sensitive. The singer also repeatedly referred to Manish Goel as a ‘professor’, questioning why the actor was offended by the description.
 Manish Goel, however, maintained that he had always treated Qazi Touqeer warmly and even recalled making tea for him earlier that day. As the argument intensified, the actor defended his identity and professional achievements, telling Qazi Touqeer, “I don’t look like a professor; I am a good-looking guy, I am an actor on Indian television. I have done 30 shows in 25 years; I am a star on TV, I am not a professor.”
 The confrontation left Manish Goel visibly distressed, and he subsequently experienced an asthma attack. He also requested Qazi Touqeer to maintain his distance, expressing disappointment over how their friendship had deteriorated.

 Manish Goel Reveals Childhood Trauma As Wife Poonam Goel Defends Him 
 The argument continued even after the nomination activity, with Qazi Touqeer questioning why the word ‘professor’ affected Manish Goel so deeply. The actor hinted that the remark was connected to something traumatic from his school days. Later, while speaking to fellow contestants Love Gill, Kanika Mann and Gullu, Manish Goel finally shared a glimpse of what he had endured.
 Recalling his experiences between Classes 8 and 10, the actor said, “It was the darkest phase of my life, school time; I don’t want to dig that grave ever.” He further revealed, “I was only 12-13 years old; some things you don’t dig up forever because they are very dark. I try not to think about it all, but if I have to sum it up, I tried to commit suicide. That’s all I would say.”
 Manish Goel’s wife, actress Poonam Goel, also addressed the controversy through Instagram. She alleged that Qazi Touqeer had repeatedly used nicknames such as ‘Gyani Baba’ and ‘Professor’ to provoke her husband, despite knowing that the remarks upset him. She also claimed that Qazi Touqeer had once told the cameras that he would make Manish Goel cry.
 Defending her husband, Poonam Goel described him as an emotional, genuine family man who does not seek screen time through unnecessary confrontations. She urged viewers to understand the context behind his reaction rather than dismissing his feelings.
